text:
amanda: Heads-up — thinking about adding a "golden input" check into the model onboarding flow. Question: do we require golden-input parity before allowing runtime latency smoke tests, or can those be gated separately? tradeoff is slower onboarding vs catching regressions early. cc @kael @sanjay :thinking:

kael: I'd separate them. Golden suites are brittle and costly to maintain across variants/quantizations. For high-risk models (PII/finance) require golden pass. For others allow a provisional "latency-first" pass with a strict canary and short TTL.

sanjay: We need concrete thresholds to implement. Proposal: golden_match >= 0.92 (token-level fuzzy), p95_latency_ms <= 120 on target infra, GPU memory < 12GB. If golden unknown, fail only on severe latency breach (p95 > 200ms) otherwise route to canary.

amanda: Example gate config (proposal):
```json
{
  "gates": {
    "golden_match": 0.92,
    "p95_latency_ms": 120,
    "memory_mb": 12288,
    "fallthrough_policy": "canary",
    "canary_traffic_pct": 10,
    "canary_duration_min": 60
  }
}
```

lina: Operational note: golden suite maintenance is the big cost. Suggest two tiers: "core golden" (~50 short prompts, run in CI) and "edge golden" (~200 diverse prompts, run nightly). Core should catch obvious regressions; edge is for signal collection. Also document owner + update cadence.

eval-bot: automated-run: model-x v1.3-q4 — core: PASS (50/50), edge: WARN (46/200 match), p95=130ms, avg_tokens=42, quantized=true. logs: <internal link omitted>.

kael: With p95=130ms we're close to threshold. If golden passes but latency slightly over, fallback options: 1) automatic canary with 10% traffic + gated rollback, 2) route to a higher-tier variant (dedicated pool) for first N hours. I'd prefer option 1 as default.

amanda: Agreed — canonical rule: golden pass + latency fail => allow canary (10%) + 30m monitoring window, else block. golden fail => block. I'll draft PR to update onboarding spec. @lina can you own golden suite + playbook? :thumbsup:

lina: Yup, I'll own it. Will add docs for update cadence, ownership, and sample prompts.

sanjay: I'll add the thresholds into the bench harness and annotate telemetry: tags like gate:golden, gate:latency, gate:canary. Also will add a small smoke test to fail CI if core golden drops below 90%.

amanda: Next steps: Amanda to open RFC-followup ticket INF-4321 with the config + playbook stub. Kael/Sanjay to finalize fallback rules. Lina to own golden inputs. We'll iterate after a week with bench stats.

amanda: Filing ticket: <https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-4321|INF-4321> — please add comments there with objections or edge cases. Thanks! :raised_hands:
